info.description: Executable authentication, profile, and account-access contracts. See API.md and ACCOUNT_ACCESS.md for policy and operational details.

502.description: Upstream response unavailable; rotation outcome is unknown. Do not replay the refresh token. Reauthenticate.

504.description: Upstream response unavailable; rotation outcome is unknown. Do not replay the refresh token. Reauthenticate.

post.description: Single-use refresh rotation. Never automatically retry after timeout or connection loss: rotation may have committed. Reauthenticate and revoke the old session. Gateway 502/504 reports X-Refresh-Outcome: unknown. Idempotency-Key does not make refresh replay safe.
